habilidades.description: In English. A nameable technical capability in three to six words, the way it would appear in a search for who knows how to do it. Never a bare tool, never a category like backend or DevOps, never a personal quality. Only what clears the highlight bar: six tasks, two periods, presence in the recent period. If only two clear it, list two.

resumo.description: Three paragraphs of running text in English, with NO task numbers. This is where the reader decides whether the rest is worth reading; the following sections carry the evidence. Cite a task by title only when indispensable.

forcas.description: In English. What each skill means in practice, told through what the person did, and since when. No résumé adjectives.

evolucao.description: In English. Where they started, where they are, and whether the change is theirs or the team's. If nothing changed, that is the sentence: nothing changed, and here is what the stability consists of.

atencao.description: In English. The gaps in their honest framing — gaps of the record, not of competence — and what is sitting still.

titulo.description: In English. One sentence saying what the person was doing there.

texto.description: In English. One paragraph, telling the change as a story, not as a table.

tarefas_citadas.description: Two or three real task titles from this period, kept in their original language — a title is a quote, and quotes are not translated.

dominio.description: In English. A specific technical area: observability with OpenTelemetry, secrets management with Vault. Never backend nor best practices.

demonstrou.description: In English. What the person demonstrated doing in it.

periodos.description: Which of the three periods it appears in.

mais_recente.description: YYYY-MM of the most recent evidence.

evidencia.description: Task numbers present in the material. At most three.

destaques.description: Only domains with six or more tasks, in at least two periods, with evidence in the recent period. Everything else goes to lacunas.

forma.description: In English. rala: 3 to 5 tasks. envelhecida: absent from the recent period — write 'not observed since YYYY-MM', never 'abandoned'. trava: the COMPLETED tasks name a blocker.

observado.description: In English. A gap of the RECORD, not of competence: not observing is not not knowing.

lacunas.description: When none of the three forms holds, return an empty list. A report that always finds a weakness is not reading.

do_time_nao_da_pessoa.description: In English. The counterweight to the trajectory: what changed in the person's material AND in the project over the same months, and therefore was NOT attributed to them. Use the verdict already computed in the material.

alocacao.description: In English. Only the highlighted domains. It says WHERE the evidence already exists — it does not recommend a role, a title, leadership or a team.

recomendacoes.description: In English. Each one born from something in this material. Generic career advice does not count.

nao_alcanca.description: In English, with the numbers of this case: how many descriptions were written by someone else, how many tasks are shared, which periods have thin records. And what never becomes a task: reviews, mentoring, conversations — the record does not reach them.

escreveu_para_outros.description: O que a pessoa escreveu para OUTRAS executarem — issue #364. Os dois números vêm calculados no material e MUST ser reproduzidos como estão; nunca recalcule. A interpretação MUST se limitar ao que o texto das tarefas sustenta: se traz contexto e critério, ou se não traz — que também é achado. NUNCA rotule a pessoa: liderança é conclusão de quem lê, e escrever tarefa para outros também é papel de quem faz triagem, escreve requisito, coordena entrega, ou é o único com permissão no repositório.

tarefas.description: quantas tarefas ela escreveu e outras executaram, do material

pessoas_distintas.description: quantas pessoas distintas as executaram. Discrimina melhor que o total: muitas tarefas para uma pessoa e poucas para muitas são coisas diferentes

o_texto_mostra.description: o que a AMOSTRA do texto sustenta sobre como ela escreve para outros — contexto e critério presentes, ou ausentes. Frase descritiva, nunca rótulo de papel

tarefas_citadas.description: os números das tarefas da amostra que sustentam a frase
